tools.title: Size profiler
tools.line: Shows what makes a .wasm big: biggest functions and data, size by section, import module and crate, and the call chain that keeps a function in the build.

tools.title: Compare two builds
tools.line: Compares two .wasm builds: functions added, removed, grown and shrunk, section sizes, imports and exports, with a Markdown size table for pull requests.

tools.title: Source mapping
tools.line: Reads DWARF line tables or a source map: the source file and line of each function, code size per source file, and source lines next to the WAT.
